results.details: Single catalog, reproducible pnpm lock and 14-service Maven reactor
No denied or unknown Node/Maven licenses
1,108 locked Node components and 21 direct Maven components after the mobile toolchain upgrade
0 high, 0 critical across 1,120 audited dependencies (8 low, 7 moderate); the production-only audit reports 0 advisories at every severity

rollbackEvidence.details: No vulnerability waiver or unsupported Vite 6 mobile override was introduced

knownGaps: The 4.x/5.x uni-app Vue3 line still declares an exact Vite 5.2.8 peer and has no patched Vite, so remaining on it is no longer possible; apps/mobile is now on the 10.x line.
8 low and 7 moderate advisories remain. They are dev-only except adm-zip, whose upstream has no fixed release (patched_versions "<0.0.0"); the policy only fails on high/critical.
The uni-app plugin pins preserveSymlinks: true, so pnpm's isolated layout needs a narrow publicHoistPattern for pinia's runtime dependencies.
nextSteps: Independent review of this submission (implementer submitted to REVIEW; acceptance is the reviewer's decision).
Re-evaluate whether src/compat/vue.ts and the vue-router entry shim are still required once a later uni-app line stops importing the Vue internals they provide.
